limits: No CUDA-event forward timings, transfer timings, serialization/write timings, input-validation timings or model-loader timings were saved.
NVML arithmetic sample mean is neither FLOP occupancy nor a wall-time-weighted measure of the whole allocation. Raw sample timestamps and utilization history are not preserved in summary.
GPU monitoring starts after model loading and covers prefill plus CPU validation/commit waits;81samples do not determine exact monitored seconds.
Torch peak allocation and NVML whole-device memory have different scopes; generic telemetry mentions KV memory but this capture explicitly used no KV cache.
No total prompt-token throughput was recorded in this summary.
Allocation-minus-attempt elapsed cannot be attributed entirely to startup, file I/O or validation.
Short completed scientifically useful work should not be repeated merely to increase a utilization percentage.
